author: CBR
description:
Johnny Yong Bosch opens up about channeling personal grief into his voice acting, including how losing his brother to cancer shaped the way he connects with characters. 

In this Heroes Journey Short, Bosch explains how real emotion, tragedy, and healing can influence a performance and make character moments feel more truthful.
